content: Hello, thanks for reaching out to support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need help recovering my daughter’s school portal account. She can’t remember her password.
No problem. Can you go to the school portal website and click on the “Forgot Password?” link below the login box?
Okay, I see the link and clicked it. It’s asking for her username or email.
Great. Please enter your daughter’s school email address, for example, hername@student.school.edu, and submit.
Done. Now it says I need to answer her security question.
Go ahead and answer the security question as best as you can. Once answered, click ‘Next’ to continue.
I answered the question and moved forward. It’s asking to set a new password now.
Perfect. Please create a new password — make sure it’s something secure and easy to remember — and confirm it.
Password changed! She’s able to log in now. Thank you for your help.
